body:
Battery Global Advisors ("BGA"), an investment firm providing customized wealth management within an institutional family office framework, today announced the final closing of the BGA Digital Infrastructure Fund ("DIF"), with $208.5 million in total capital commitments. DIF invests in data center and digital infrastructure assets at the corporate layer of the infrastructure value chain, targeting platforms with contracted revenue, secured power, and established assets.

DIF exceeded its $150 million target following support from institutions, technology entrepreneurs, and venture capital and private equity executives. To date, the Fund has committed capital to five portfolio companies, representing approximately 40% of total commitments. The near-term investment pipeline remains active, with several opportunities currently in late-stage diligence. BGA engaged PJT Park Hill as the placement agent for DIF and other digital infrastructure engagements.

Since 2024, BGA has committed more than $900 million to the digital infrastructure sector across its fund and co-investment vehicles. BGA's opportunistic mandate allows the firm to pursue niche, high-growth opportunities that fall outside the constraints of traditional institutional mandates, and its relationships across the technology community have made it a preferred capital provider for management teams and development partners.

“We built DIF with the flexibility to pursue our highest-conviction opportunities wherever they sit in the digital infrastructure ecosystem,” said Brandon Colón, Chief Investment Officer of Battery Global Advisors. “The mandate lets us underwrite situations that fall outside traditional institutional boxes, and given the growing complexity of financing needs, makes us an attractive partner to management teams and developers.”

“We are grateful for the confidence our investors have placed in the Fund. DIF is well positioned to support the evolving digital infrastructure build-out given BGA’s strong history within the real estate, venture, and technology communities,” said John O’Connor, Chief Executive Officer of Battery Global Advisors. “Exceeding our target with support from this investor base tells us our platform and strategy resonate with the market.”

Battery Global Advisors provides customized wealth management within an institutional family office framework. BGA manages over $7.6 billion in assets for venture capital and private equity executives and technology entrepreneurs, blending traditional wealth management with access to a diverse set of investment opportunities. “BGA Digital Infrastructure Fund” is the marketing name for BGA Private Opportunities Fund, LLC – Digital Infrastructure Series. BGA is based in Boston, MA. For more information, please visit www.bga.com .
